Following Jensen Huang's resignation as Nvidia's CEO last week, Trump told reporters on Monday that he's open to seeing Huang return and that he's not certain that the woman Huang reportedly had an affair with was in fact a spy.

"I think having Jensen go back- a lot of people are asking Jensen, they think Jensen should go back. That certainly isn't a bad idea." Trump said he "would not mind" seeing Huang return as CEO, adding, "I threw out the name of Tim Cook, but I would say that Jensen's reinstatement- I think he learned a big lesson, I guess maybe one lesson more important than another, but I would certainly not mind seeing that."
